primitives.summary: A contract version is an immutable artifacts/<version> tree, a catalog and a manifest produced by one release builder; published versions are never rewritten.

guarantees.statement: Generated bytes match the builder output.

primitives.summary: Installs, audits and rolls back the complete shared tuple (package, contract, catalog) in a HOME.

guarantees.statement: Doctor reports drift between the installed tuple and its manifest.

primitives.summary: Catalogued skills with pinned sources, folder hashes and harness variants; external skills carry upstream provenance.
PreToolUse guard for Claude Code and Codex: blocks destructive commands, guard-config writes and test-file writes outside an operator grant.

guarantees.statement: The installed guard blocks git reset --hard, a test-file write without a grant and an agent self-grant.

primitives.summary: Stop hook that asks once for a short closing in the thread when a turn changed files and its last message has none; it never asks for a report or a tunnel.
Checks that an AGENTS.md or lint migration kept every rule of its base.
Private append-only log of mistakes (repeated ones become proposed hard rules) and frictions (paper cuts the Steward triages).
docs/architecture/primitives.json schema v1 and its validator.

guarantees.statement: Active primitives point at existing files and symbols.

primitives.summary: The merge gate of a PR's exact head: Codex threads answered (not resolved), one review request per head, review rounds (Sol 6.1 High; Fable 5.2 for security work and hard reviews) and coverage, evidence, and one next action in words. For a PR into develop no route ends in the owner.

guarantees.statement: With base develop no combination of gate facts ends in ownerDecides.

primitives.summary: One authority for PR reviews, Sol 6.1 High by default and Fable 5.2 for security work and hard reviews: slots reserved per branch lineage with no owner approval, five rounds and up to seven for a critical finding, verified records, dispositions per finding, the advance at the cap, voids and follow-up classification; the Claude Agent and delegate_task hooks and codex-review reserve through it.

guarantees.statement: No review round runs past the fifth unless a critical finding is open, and none past the seventh.

primitives.summary: Claude roster guard: named roles and models, a read-only search grammar for mappers, and a coach that never blocks and tells the parent once to use a mapper after ten solo reads, to launch ready lanes together, and to batch secret requests.

guarantees.statement: The tenth counted parent read prints a coach hint and a subagent's reads print nothing.

primitives.summary: Renders completion reports and other documents in the approved presentation.

One text format for progress answers and closings, with the facts of an initiative's PRs printed by `development-system progress`; the closing says what was done, the status against done, what is needed and what follows; the line-and-window renderer is for substantive plans and on request and writes every stage out, and the report (on request) and questionnaire renderers remain separate.
Weekly read-only review of the allowlisted repositories with a private ledger of pending recommendations.
Shared and host-specific instructions rendered from one roster and one body.
